adds.title: Ukrainian Civil Code (2011 amendment) and 2016 transgender procedure reform + August 2016 ruling
adds.summary: Effective from late December 2016, Ukraine no longer requires transgender people seeking legal gender change to petition a board of mental health professionals or spend a month in a psychiatric facility.

adds.title: 2009 Gender Identity Law - General Assembly law on name and legal gender change
adds.summary: Approved 12 October 2009, promulgated 25 October 2009 and published 17 November 2009, Uruguay Law No. 18.620 establishes the right to free development of personality in accordance with self-perceived gender identity independent of biological, genetic, anatomical, morphological, hormonal or assigned sex and provides that any person whose registered name, sex or both conflict with that identity may obtain alignment on civil-registry acts and on identity, electoral, travel and other identification documents without required sex-reassignment surgery upon proof of discordance and its stability/persistence for at least two years through a Family Court voluntary process with a specialized multidisciplinary report, with changes notified to civil-identification and electoral authorities while retaining the same identity, passport and civic-credential number and with full exercise of rights inherent to the new sex condition.
